dataset: M5 daily sales, CA_1 store, FOODS_1/FOODS_2/FOODS_3
selection: 20 eligible items per food department, ascending SHA256(id); only sales through train_end used for eligibility
eligibility: at least 60 positive days in 2015 and positive sales in first 90 training days
checkpoint_selection: minimum validation likelihood loss; no test tuning
operational_neural_prediction: arithmetic mean of each quantile across three seeds per architecture
forecast_evaluation: two nonoverlapping 28-day blocks beginning 2016-03-28 and 2016-04-25; update historical inputs but never retrain on test

inventory.initial_stock: ceil(pretest last-28-day mean times (lead+review)), same for every method
inventory.policy: production ml.purchasing.plan_order, median quantile, pack=MOQ=1; fixed lead, receipts before daily demand, lost sales, no backlog
inventory.information: all methods receive the same realized historical sales daily, as a controlled counterfactual comparison; no simulated lost-sale feedback

inference: 10000 paired SKU cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 20261101; descriptive pointwise 95% intervals, no familywise significance claim
scope: external food-sales benchmark and conditional inventory simulation; not Kazakhstan deployment or measured KZT savings
